method: Original C++ physics, generated platforms and GLES renderer compiled to WebAssembly. Cocoa windowing/paths and FMOD effects use browser platform glue.
titleStatus: Descriptive working title; original archived as game.
audio: Original WAV effects. Archived Ambient Dreams XM rendered with libopenmpt and encoded to MP3 for browser streaming; host starts the ambient loop.
restart: Restores original setup snapshots for player, camera, initial platforms and enemies.
observer: Read-only getters; no game-state setters used by browser tests.
